evals.prompt: I have a single-module Android app using Jetpack Compose. Set up lumo-ui so I can start adding its components, and wire up the theme.
evals.expected_output: Applies the com.nomanr.plugin.lumo Gradle plugin, runs --init, configures lumo.properties, adds the required dependencies, runs --setup, and wraps the app in the generated theme.
expectations: Applies the plugin with id("com.nomanr.plugin.lumo") in a plugins block, not as an implementation dependency
Runs ./gradlew lumo --init and explains the ThemeName, ComponentsDir, PackageName and KotlinMultiplatform keys in lumo.properties
Uses ./gradlew lumo --required-deps to find the dependencies to add
Runs ./gradlew lumo --setup to generate Theme.kt, Color.kt and Typography.kt
Wraps setContent content in the generated theme composable (AppTheme by default)

evals.prompt: My lumo.properties has ThemeName=AcmeTheme and PackageName=com.acme.ui, and TopBar and IconButton are already generated. Add a top bar to my ProfileScreen with a back arrow, the title "Profile" and an overflow menu button.
evals.expected_output: A TopBar whose single content slot holds a Row with a back IconButton, a Text title and an overflow IconButton, using the user's theme and package names.
expectations: Reads or refers to the generated TopBar.kt instead of assuming Material3's API
Passes the back button, title and overflow button inside TopBar's trailing content lambda, not as title, navigationIcon or actions parameters
Imports TopBar from com.acme.ui.components.topbar and IconButton from com.acme.ui.components
Uses AcmeTheme.typography or AcmeTheme.colors, not AppTheme or MaterialTheme
Uses a valid IconButtonVariant such as Ghost or PrimaryGhost

evals.prompt: Using lumo-ui, show a confirmation dialog before deleting an account, and make the delete button look destructive.
evals.expected_output: An AlertDialog with required title and text, onConfirmClick and onDismissRequest, triggered by a Button using ButtonVariant.Destructive.
expectations: Uses lumo-ui's AlertDialog with onDismissRequest, onConfirmClick, title and text
Sets confirmButtonText and dismissButtonText (or relies on their "OK" and "Cancel" defaults)
Does not pass a modifier parameter to AlertDialog
Uses ButtonVariant.Destructive or another Destructive* variant, not DestructiveFilled
Does not import androidx.compose.material3.AlertDialog or material3.Button

evals.prompt: Add a lumo-ui progress indicator to my project and show an indeterminate spinner while a list loads.
evals.expected_output: Runs ./gradlew lumo --add ProgressIndicators and uses CircularProgressIndicator without a progress argument.
expectations: Runs ./gradlew lumo --add ProgressIndicators (plural, exact case)
Uses CircularProgressIndicator() with no progress argument for the indeterminate state
Imports the indicator from the project's PackageName rather than material3

evals.prompt: I generated Button with lumo-ui a while ago and tweaked it. Now I want all buttons to have fully rounded corners. What's the best way?
evals.expected_output: Edit the generated Button.kt directly; re-running --add won't overwrite an existing file.
expectations: Recommends editing the generated Button.kt file directly
Does not recommend wrapping Button in a new composable just to change its shape
Notes that ./gradlew lumo --add Button skips files that already exist, so it won't overwrite the user's tweaks
Does not suggest deleting and regenerating Button.kt without warning that it discards the user's changes

evals.prompt: I'm building a Kotlin Multiplatform app (Android, iOS, desktop) with lumo-ui. Add a tooltip that appears on an info icon, without the little caret.
evals.expected_output: Sets KotlinMultiplatform=true, runs --add Tooltip which writes Tooltip.kt plus per-platform files, and uses TooltipBox with Tooltip(caretSize = DpSize.Unspecified).
expectations: Checks or sets KotlinMultiplatform=true in lumo.properties
Mentions that --add Tooltip generates platform-specific files such as Tooltip.android.kt and Tooltip.ios.kt
Wraps the anchor in TooltipBox and passes a Tooltip in the tooltip lambda
Hides the caret with caretSize = DpSize.Unspecified, not a caretProperties parameter
Uses rememberTooltipPositionProvider() or the default, not TooltipDefaults.rememberPlainTooltipPositionProvider()

evals.prompt: Change my lumo-ui app's brand colors to a teal primary and support dark mode that follows the system setting.
evals.expected_output: Edits LightColors and DarkColors in the generated Color.kt and uses AppTheme(isDarkTheme = isSystemInDarkTheme()) or its default.
expectations: Edits the LightColors and DarkColors values in the generated Color.kt (not Colors.kt)
Uses the isDarkTheme parameter (or its isSystemInDarkTheme() default), not darkTheme
Does not introduce MaterialTheme, a Material3 colorScheme or *Container color roles
Updates the matching on* color (e.g. onPrimary) for contrast
